text: あら　ポケモン　もってるわね　…　カモ　だわ！

structure.jp: ポケモン　もってるわね

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a lasting state; in casual speech it shortens to てる. もってる = 'have, are carrying'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to finish a sentence, and ね after it asks the listener to agree. もってるわね = 'you do have them, don't you'.
